summary: On June 5, 2026, Wisekey International Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the confidential submission of an amended draft registration statement on Form F-4 with the SEC for its subsidiary WISeSat.Space Corp. This relates to a previously announced business combination with SPAC Columbus Acquisition Corp (Nasdaq: COLA). The definitive Business Combination Agreement was dated November 9, 2025. Upon closing, WISeSat and CAC will become subsidiaries of Pubco (WISeSat.Space Holdings Corp.), expected to trade under ticker WSAT. The transaction remains subject to SEC review, CAC shareholder approval, and Nasdaq listing approval. The business combination aims to create a Nasdaq-listed space infrastructure company leveraging the WISeKey group's trust technologies. This SEC filing represents a procedural milestone in the SPAC merger process, making the filing relevant for SPACs category.
